https://jobs.lever.co/diversified-automa.description: Position Summary: The Controls and Commissioning Co-op is part of a cross-discipline project team, supporting the successful execution of conveyor system integration projects. Under the guidance of experienced controls engineers, the co-op will assist with electrical controls engineering, PLC programming, testing, documentation, and commissioning activities while gaining hands-on experience in industrial automation and material handling systems. The Controls and Commissioning Co-op will aid in the testing, implementation, and commissioning of PLC programs used to control conveyor systems and related equipment within the Material Handling Industry. This includes participating in system testing, assisting with field commissioning activities, and helping ensure compliance with customer specifications and project requirements. The position provides valuable exposure to PLs, industrial networking, HMI systems, electrical design, troubleshooting, and field commissioning while working alongside experienced Controls Engineers. Tasks Review electrical drawings, I/O lists, control narratives, and system documentation. Participate in system testing and validation efforts to ensure compliance with design requirements. Assist with completion of testing and commissioning documentation. Support field commissioning and startup activities for assigned projects. Aid in troubleshooting PLC programs, HMIs, industrial communication networks, and field devices. Travel to customer sites to support system testing, commissioning, and startup activities. Skills Active Listening: Giving full attention to what others are saying and asking questions when appropriate. Troubleshooting: Assisting in identifying causes of equipment and system issues. Critical Thinking: Applying logical analysis to technical problems and potential solutions. Reading Comprehension: Understanding technical drawings, specifications, and engineering documentation. Complex Problem Solving: Supporting engineers in analyzing and resolving technical challenges. Technical Aptitude: Interest in industrial automation, controls systems, and material handling equipment. Ability to work effectively within a team environment. Strong organizational and communication skills. Attributes Strong desire to learn and develop technical skills. Positive attitude and strong work ethic. Problem-solving mindset and attention to detail. Ability to work independently and within a team environment. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to adapt to changing project priorities and schedules. Willingness to travel and support field activities as required. Requirements Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering field. Basic understanding of industrial automation, electrical controls, or PLC programming preferred. Familiarity with Rockwell Automation platforms, HMIs, or industrial communication networks is a plus but not required. Valid driver’s license Ability to travel up to 80-90% during co-op assignments as project needs require. Work Environment This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, etc. When traveling the job environment shifts to a site-based, typically industrial. When traveling this role routinely uses appropriate PPE, electrical diagnostic tools, electrical implementation tools, laptops, and networking equipment. Ability to lift 25 pounds Ability to climb ladders Ability to navigate safely over and around warehouse automation equipment Physical stamina may be required for prolonged standing, bending, stooping, and/or working in cramped quarters. https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/Versant.description: VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass. Senior Product Manager, AI Platform – Equity Research VERSANT is an independent, publicly traded company that brings together powerhouse brands such as CNBC, MS NOW (formerly MSNBC), USA Network, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Golf Channel, along with dynamic digital and direct-to-consumer brands such as Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow, and GolfPass. StockStory, part of CNBC and VERSANT, is building the next generation of AI-powered equity research for individual investors. We operate like a startup—a small team with high ownership, fast decisions, and direct access to leadership—while benefiting from the resources and long-term commitment of a well-capitalized public company. Our mission is simple: help millions of individual investors make better investment decisions. We’re combining AI, institutional-quality investment research, proprietary data, and exceptional engineering to redefine how retail investors discover, research, and evaluate stocks. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager with deep experience building consumer investing, financial research, or market-data products to help us build a new generation of AI-powered equity research products. This role sits at the intersection of consumer fintech, public equities, financial data, and AI. You will work with a high-caliber team that brings together top-tier engineering and buy-side investing talent, including analysts with prior experience at firms such as Millennium, Point72, and KKR. In this role, you will own and shape core product experiences across our AI equity research platform, particularly products that help investors discover stocks, conduct research, compare opportunities, understand investment theses, and build conviction. These may include AI-powered research reports, stock recommendations, screeners and discovery tools, company pages, watchlists, portfolio insights, and conversational research experiences. This is a hands-on product role for someone who wants to stay close to users, product details, data, and execution. You do not need to have worked professionally as an equity analyst, but you should be an active individual investor with strong public-markets fluency. You should understand how investors move from discovering a stock to researching the business, evaluating valuation and risk, comparing alternatives, and ultimately making an investment decision. You will identify the highest-value customer problems, define product requirements, validate assumptions with users and data, and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and Equity Research to ship experiences that make institutional-quality research accessible and actionable for a large retail investor audience. The team is part of a new organization, which means you will have meaningful influence over both the products we build and the product culture we establish. We believe in deeply understanding customer needs and behaviors, empowering product teams to solve meaningful problems, shipping useful products quickly, and iterating based on real user feedback and behavior. This is an opportunity to take significant ownership early and grow quickly as the platform and team scale. What You’ll Do Own and evolve core stock research and discovery experiences across StockStory’s AI-powered investing platform. Develop a deep understanding of our users through regular interviews, usability testing, behavioral analysis, and other forms of product discovery. Study how individual investors discover ideas, research companies, evaluate financial performance and valuation, compare stocks, build conviction, monitor investments, and make buy/sell decisions. Translate customer problems, investing workflows, competitive insights, and behavioral data into clear product opportunities, requirements, roadmaps, and execution plans. Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and Equity Research to build products that combine AI, financial data, and expert investment research into simple and compelling consumer experiences. Play an integral role in defining our AI product experience, including how AI-generated research and recommendations communicate reasoning, evidence, sources, assumptions, uncertainty, and risk. Help establish product standards for trust and quality in AI-generated financial research, working with our investment and technical teams to determine how outputs are evaluated before and after launch. Build and improve products such as AI research reports, stock discovery and screening tools, company research experiences, investment recommendations, watchlists, portfolio insights, and conversational research interfaces. Define clear success metrics for the products you own, including relevant activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and research-behavior metrics. Analyze funnels and user behavior, run experiments, synthesize qualitative and quantitative feedback, and iterate quickly based on what users actually do. Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape across consumer brokerages, investing platforms, financial research products, market-data tools, and emerging AI investing products. Communicate product strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, decisions, results, and progress clearly across Product, Design, Engineering, Equity Research, and senior leadership. What We’re Looking For Minimum of 5 years of product management experience, including meaningful experience building B2C consumer-facing products serving retail or individual customers. Demonstrated experience owning products used by self-directed retail investors, ideally across one or more of the following areas: stock discovery, screeners, equity research, market data, company/fundamental data, watchlists, portfolio analytics, investment recommendations, financial news, or AI-powered investing tools. Strong public-equities fluency. You should understand financial statements, earnings, valuation multiples, consensus estimates, catalysts, investment theses, and the basic process investors use to evaluate public companies. Proven ability to take consumer product features from discovery through launch and iteration, including customer interviews, problem definition, PRDs/product requirements, prioritization, engineering execution, launch planning, experimentation, and post-launch measurement. Experience building high-engagement consumer or subscription products, with a strong understanding of activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and the behaviors that drive recurring product usage. Strong quantitative product instincts and experience using behavioral data, funnels, cohort analysis, experimentation, and product metrics to make decisions and evaluate launches. Experience working with data-intensive products and translating complex information into consumer experiences that are intuitive, useful, and trustworthy. Experience building AI-powered consumer products or features is strongly preferred. You should understand the opportunities and product challenges associated with LLM-generated content, including accuracy, explainability, source attribution, user trust, latency, and evaluation. Exceptional product judgment and attention to detail. You should be able to combine customer research, quantitative evidence, competitive insight, and your own judgment to determine what should—and should not—be built. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate user problems, product rationale, requirements, tradeoffs, metrics, and launch plans to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. High agency and a builder mentality. You are comfortable operating with incomplete information, making decisions, getting into the details, and moving quickly in an early-stage environment. https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/thetrad.description: The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with nearly 4,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more. Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly. The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you. Who we are: Ventura OS is a new Smart TV operating system being built inside The Trade Desk, the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising. Where the wider company runs a global-scale DSP, Ventura is closer to a startup inside it: a small team, direct influence over product direction, and a real OS shipping to real devices in real living rooms. We’re deliberately building the CTV supply chain differently: more efficient for advertisers and publishers, more relevant for viewers, and more transparent end-to-end. The backend that powers all of it is being built now, and the Infra team is the critical foundation for it. About the Team: Infra is the foundation Ventura OS is built on. We own the compute, storage, and networking, including our Kubernetes platform, that every Ventura runs on, plus the source control and CI/CD pipelines that turn code into shipped products. We power the GPU and ML-serving infrastructure behind applied science and AI-assisted tools. We own every build system across AOSP platform, client experience and mobile, along with the lab infrastructure and release pipelines that keep platform engineering moving. We run build-test-deploy infrastructure for every app in the Ventura ecosystem, first-party and third. And we deliver telemetry end to end — from client ingestion to the dashboards leadership reads. If it runs, ships, trains, or gets measured on Ventura OS, it runs on infrastructure we built. What You’ll Do: You'll be an end-to-end owner of the systems this team runs — designing, building, operating, monitoring, and setting the standards other inherit. As a member of the Infrastructure team, you'll be responsible for the scalability, performance, reliability, and visibility of every cloud service powering Ventura TV OS. In addition to the core responsibilities of a backend engineer, you will: Build, automate, and operate the compute (VMs, Kubernetes), networking (VPN, edge services), database (SQL/NoSQL), storage, and identity services every Ventura partner team depends on — using infrastructure-as-code and automation-first practices, and forecasting capacity needs ahead of demand for compute, storage, and GPU resources. Partner with application teams to design, implement, and scale the services and infrastructure behind their products. Own the identity, security, and compliance model for Ventura OS cloud services — authentication, authorization, audit, and adherence to security and compliance standards for every request, from internal employees to external partners. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize system performance and cost while balancing availability, efficiency, and cloud spend across the infrastructure we run. Deliver highly available build infrastructure (GitLab, Jenkins, Gerrit) and developer tooling relied on by internal engineers and external partner vendors alike. Own AOSP platform, client experience and mobile build systems, lab infrastructure, release pipelines, and shared platform-engineering tooling plus build, test, and deployment infrastructure for first- and third-party Ventura apps. Lead the GPU infrastructure and model-serving platforms behind applied science workloads and AI-assisted tools, including code review and incident-response automation. Own end-to-end telemetry infrastructure — client-side ingestion, processing pipelines, data warehousing, and analytics reporting with data privacy and governance built in by design. Drive major infrastructure and platform migrations, and lead adoption of new tools and standards across the org Own operational excellence for every service we run — observability, SLOs, on-call, incident response, disaster recovery and business continuity planning, and the documentation and runbooks that keep teams resilient during handoffs. Who You Are: One of the best things about working here is the sheer variety of technical challenges. We don't expect you to know every technology we use on day one — what matters is that you learn quickly and solve complex problems with the best tool for the job. What you already know matters less than how well you adapt, think critically, and figure things out. We're looking for a software engineer with a genuine passion for infrastructure — someone energized by hard, open-ended problems, not just familiar ones. Culture matters here. Ventura is a small, high-impact team inside The Trade Desk, and we take pride in engineers who build trust, give generously, solve problems scrappily, and pursue excellence with grit. In practice, that means working with confidence and without ego: holding well-reasoned opinions while welcoming ideas different from your own, being quick to spot trade-offs, and staying willing to be proven wrong. It also means showing up for your teammates when things get hard. You don't have to check every box below — if you check most of them, you're likely to thrive in this role. What You Bring: 6+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time on cloud platforms or distributed systems. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience — we care more about what you can contribute than your credentials. A sustained track record of self-directed, end-to-end ownership of complex, high-impact projects — you think beyond the immediate task of understanding the "why." Strong engineering fundamentals and first-principles thinking. At our scale, many off-the-shelf tools and techniques don't work out of the box, and you can evaluate and adapt solutions to a unique environment. Commercial development experience in a modern backend language (Node.js/TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Go, or C#). Extensive hands-on experience designing and operating cloud services and/or infrastructure in production, at a meaningful scale. Strong background in infrastructure-as-code and automation, and the discipline to get it right. Hands-on experience instrumenting production services for observability — metrics (e.g., Prometheus), structured logging, distributed tracing — and operating with SLO-driven, on-call rigor. Solid understanding of relational and NoSQL data stores (Postgres, MySQL, Redis, or similar), including safe tenant-scoped data modeling. Experience owning a shared platform that other engineering teams build on — codifying standards, running "paved paths," and driving adoption without disrupting partner teams' delivery. A track record of sound technical decision-making, with experience of mentoring engineers through code and design review. Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences, and comfort scoping and sequencing work under ambiguity. Nice to Have Qualifications: Deep understanding of cloud services and Kubernetes on AWS, GCP, or Azure at scale. Exposure to identity/security systems (authN/authZ, audit) in a production environment. Familiarity with GPU infrastructure or ML-serving platforms. Background in Smart TV, OTT, or CTV services — or on any infrastructure layer that backs up a hardware fleet or a consumer-facing OS. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/teraswitch/c16e.description: Engineered to outperform, Teraswitch is on a mission to provide high-performance infrastructure services for critical workloads. With 25+ datacenter locations around the world interconnected by our low latency global backbone network, we are the class leader in performance bare metal hosting and rapidly expanding into additional infrastructure services. THE JOB The Network Engineering team at Teraswitch designs and operates our low-latency global backbone and the network services layered on top of it. This role leads the rollout and ongoing operation of our F5 application delivery and security platform across 25+ points of presence — global server load balancing, L4–L7 application delivery and SSL/TLS termination, WAF, and DDoS mitigation — for a multi-tenant, service-provider environment. You'll own the F5 fleet end to end: architecture and standardization, device onboarding and provisioning at scale, day-to-day operations, and automation. This role reports to the Principal Network Architect. Title and level will be calibrated to your experience, technical depth, and demonstrated scope of ownership. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Drive the global deployment of our F5 platform across 25+ points of presence, establishing standardized, repeatable designs for application delivery and security - Work with the broader Network and Software Engineering teams to build and improve customer self-service experiences for F5 delivered services - Architect and operate global server load balancing with BIG-IP DNS (GTM) — anycast, wide IPs, and topology / geolocation-based steering with health-driven failover across POPs - Design, deploy, and tune L4–L7 load balancing and SSL/TLS termination (LTM), including traffic profiles, certificate management, and iRules for advanced traffic handling - Build and operate WAF (F5 Advanced WAF / ASM) and DDoS mitigation (AFM and behavioral L3–L7 defenses) to protect multi-tenant customer workloads - Integrate F5 with the routing layer via BGP — route health injection and anycast VIP advertisement into our global backbone - Onboard, provision, and manage the F5 fleet at scale using custom provisioning, control, and automation (iControl REST, Ansible, Python) - Improve reliability through observability (F5 Telemetry Streaming into our metrics and logging stack), alerting, incident response, and postmortems BASIC QUALIFICATIONS - Deep, hands-on experience designing and operating F5 BIG-IP in production, including LTM (L4–L7 load balancing and SSL/TLS termination) and iRules - Strong applied networking fundamentals across the L2–L7 path — TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and TLS - Working knowledge of BGP and dynamic routing, and how they integrate with application delivery (e.g., route health injection, anycast) - F5 automation experience (iControl REST and/or declarative config via AS3 and Declarative Onboarding) - Configuration management (Ansible) and/or scripting experience (Python, bash) - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment - Committed to operational best practices and security by design - A balance of AI-assisted development and actual understanding of the technologies in use. PREFERRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE You do not need all of these — depth in a few areas plus strong fundamentals is sufficient: - F5 experience in a service or hosting provider environment specifically — multi-tenant design, automation-first operations, and scalable, secure delivery (as distinct from single-tenant enterprise) - Global server load balancing at scale with BIG-IP DNS / GTM - WAF policy design and tuning, including bot defense, with F5 Advanced WAF / ASM - DDoS mitigation across L3–L7 (AFM, DDoS Hybrid Defender, behavioral DoS) - Multi-tenant isolation using vCMP, route domains, and partitions - Fleet management and centralized operations of F5 Systems - Infrastructure-as-code and GitOps for network / ADC configuration (Terraform F5 provider, CI/CD pipelines for config) - Operating and upgrading F5 platforms at scale (TMOS lifecycle; rSeries / VELOS / F5OS or BIG-IP Next a plus) - NGINX and/or F5 Distributed Cloud (XC) experience - F5 certification (e.g., F5 Certified Technology Specialist / CTS, or higher) - Demonstrated ability to design and operate automation-first infrastructure at scale ON-CALL / OPERATIONS Participate in an on-call system supporting critical production systems. LOCATION Preference given to full-time onsite candidates in Pittsburgh, PA, followed by hybrid candidates. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS Along with a competitive pay scale, full-time Teraswitch employees are eligible for the following benefits: - Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance - 401(k) with company profit sharing - PTO and 11 Company Paid Holidays

https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/rev/938419c6-51.description: There’s never been a more exciting time to be part of Rev. Collaborate with firmware, controls, and runtime engineers to define testability requirements and turn real-world failures into repeatable automated test cases. Drive validation burn-down during integration and assembly milestones, tracking issues to closure across teams. Requirements: Technical degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience and evidence of exceptional ability. Strong software engineering fundamentals, with fluency in Python and comfort in C/C++ or Rust for debugging at the firmware level. Demonstrated experience building validation, simulation, or test infrastructure for real physical systems — robots, motors, actuators, or similar. You are comfortable with ambiguity, move fast, and have an "engineering curiosity" that drives you to understand how the entire system works, not just your part. Nice to Haves: Experience validating or testing robotics middleware or runtime systems (ROS2 or similar). Experience with dynamic modeling or simulation tools (MATLAB/Simulink, MuJoCo, Gazebo, or equivalent) for robotic or actuated systems. Familiarity with functional safety standards (IEC 61508, ISO 13849, ISO 26262, or similar) and safety validation processes. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/1x/7d93444c-01f.description: ABOUT 1X We’re building humanoid robots that work in home, doing the chores, handling the tasks, and giving people their time back. In this role you’ll develop and improve the processes that take parts from raw stock to assembled, tested hardware, build the fixtures and workflows that make production repeatable, and feed what you learn on the floor straight back into the next robot revision. Every process you stand up moves NEO closer to shipping at scale, which means your work is production-critical, not a side project. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS - Hands-on experience in manufacturing or mechanical engineering. - Basic CAD skills (SolidWorks, Onshape, or similar). - Comfortable doing physical work, including setup, assembly, and post-processing. - Currently studying engineering or a related field. PREFERRED SKILLS - Prior work on manufacturing processes, fixturing, robotics, mechatronics, or general hardware projects. - Exposure to design for manufacturability, process validation, or production scale-up. WHAT DOES A SUCCESSFUL 1X TEAM MEMBER LOOK LIKE Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect. On the Manufacturing Engineering team specifically, that shows up as: - Own It. You take responsibility. If a process is broken or a part won’t build, you fix it. - Move Fast. You make smart calls and iterate quickly instead of overanalyzing. - Be Resourceful. You figure things out when tools, time, or info are limited. - Learn & Improve. You absorb feedback, learn fast, and get better every week. - Build Trust. You do what you say, communicate clearly, and follow through. If you know how to build and can figure things out quickly, that matters more to us than checking every box. https://www.amazon.jobs/en/jobs/10496460.description: Design the systems that support millions of people at work. When someone at Amazon has a question about any HR topic like their pay, their leave, a benefit, or a sensitive situation with their team, we own the platform and tools that enable our HR teams to efficiently and effectively support all Amazonians. We are rebuilding that experience on a single, intelligent platform called Service Central, a unified place where employees get answers and where the specialists who support them do their work. We are looking for a Sr. UX Designer to shape how those products look, feel, and behave from end to end. You will own design for complex, high-scale products where the routine is handled quickly and automatically, so that the people who support employees can spend their time on the questions that need judgment, empathy, and care. This is a rare chance to define new patterns from the ground up, on products used by a very large, global audience across all the countries we operate in, support multiple languages, and to set the standard that other design teams build on. What sets this role apart: - You will design at a scale that reaches millions of people, and your patterns will be reused far beyond your own products. - You will define how intelligent, human-centered products behave in a domain where trust, clarity, and a clear path to a real person matter more than almost anywhere else. - You will work through genuine ambiguity, shaping problems that do not yet have an established design language. Key job responsibilities - Own end-to-end design for complex products on Service Central, translating user insight, business goals, and technical constraints into intuitive experiences across web and mobile. - Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, with the detailed specifications engineering needs to build with confidence. - Design intelligent, human-centered interactions that keep people informed and in control: making it clear when a suggestion is a recommendation to accept or refine, and when a request is being handled by a person rather than an automated step. - Set direction on ambiguous problems, articulate trade-offs and rationale, and align designers, product managers, engineers, and business leaders around a shared vision. - Contribute reusable patterns and standards back to the wider design community, particularly for how people and intelligent systems work together. A day in the life You will work alongside designers, researchers, product managers, engineers, and data scientists to invent and refine end-to-end experiences. A typical week moves between two altitudes. Some days you are deep in the craft of a single flow, deciding how a specialist reviews a case, sees the context they need, and confirms or adjusts a recommended next step before anything happens. Other days you are zoomed out, shaping how an entire product fits together and communicating that vision to senior leaders who help clear the path. A recurring design question runs through the work: for any given task, should the product complete it automatically, offer a suggestion for a person to approve, or hand off to a human who owns it end to end? You will help make that judgment visible and trustworthy in the interface, so the experience always feels considerate and in the person's control. You will move quickly from sketches and prototypes to high-fidelity design, put your ideas in front of real users, and refine based on what you learn. About the team HR Experience Technology designs and builds the products people rely on when they need support at work. Our customers are the many HR roles across the company, that help our Amazonians checking a pay issue, to a specialist resolving a complex, sensitive case. Our purpose is to make their working lives easier through thoughtful, high-quality design. We bring interaction design, visual design, service design, and research together into one user-centered practice. Our vision is a support experience that feels simple and personal at a scale of millions, delivered through one connected platform rather than a patchwork of separate tools. Over the coming years we are reimagining how that support works, using technology to take the friction out of routine tasks so the people who support employees can focus on the moments that matter most. You will help lead that shift, and your work will shape both the products and the standards we design by.
